![ABOUT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/281e284e50651ad4929bf7e6954c45ccf9b25c2c_0.webp)
 **This modpack, which works on the client side, adds features that fit PERFECTLY into vanilla. And shaders are added, for the BEST experience.**
# 
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1afe6729e37add2860265880e647fce352891d7f_0.webp)
> * sorry for grammatic error!
1. Inventory sorting
2. Improved rain
3. Cool animations
4. Smooth interface (GUI)
5. Background blur
6. Click and run** feature
7. And more...
* ** Click and run. All done! No need to configure Minecraft. Everything is for you.
